description: This file defines a service for OpenClaw plugins that integrates OpenTelemetry for diagnostics, including tracing, metrics, and logging. It sets up exporters, samplers, and event handlers for diagnostic events, enabling telemetry data collection and export.

methods.name: normalizeEndpoint
methods.description: Trims trailing slashes from an endpoint URL.

methods.name: resolveOtelUrl
methods.description: Constructs the full OpenTelemetry URL for traces, metrics, or logs based on the endpoint and path.

methods.name: resolveSampleRate
methods.description: Validates and returns a sample rate between 0 and 1.

methods.name: formatError
methods.description: Formats an error or unknown value into a string for logging.

methods.name: redactOtelAttributes
methods.description: Redacts sensitive text in OpenTelemetry attributes.

methods.name: createDiagnosticsOtelService
methods.description: Creates and returns an OpenClaw plugin service that integrates OpenTelemetry diagnostics, including setup for tracing, metrics, and logging, and handles diagnostic events.
